name: team_champs
caption:
IF OUR 2019 CHAMPIONSHIP STARTERS WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🐼 Kyle Lowry = Pangoro: charges ahead, uncaring about any hits it takes. 8.7 assists a night
🎯 Danny Green = Remoraid: its ability is Sniper, superb accuracy. 45.5% from three
✂️ Kawhi Leonard = Scizor: steel pincers, not easily fazed. 30.5 a night in the playoffs, Finals MVP
🌀 Pascal Siakam = Excadrill: the Drill King, bores through steel. 16.9 a night and Most Improved Player
🧠 Marc Gasol = Metagross: four brains, smarter than a supercomputer. 38.2% from three in the playoffs

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If our twenty nineteen championship starters were Pokemon,
It charges ahead like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take.
beats.dlg: IT CHARGES AHEAD,|UNCARING ABOUT ANY HITS.

beats.vo: That's Lowry. He'd go on to become the league's leader in charges drawn since they started tracking it. Eight point seven assists a night in our title year.
beats.dlg: THE CHARGE KING:|8.7 ASSISTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: Its ability is Sniper. It has superb accuracy, and can hit moving prey from more than three hundred feet.
Danny Green lets it fly. Forty-five point five percent from three.
beats.dlg: DANNY GREEN LETS IT FLY:|45.5% FROM THREE!

beats.vo: Its steel pincers crush anything they grab, and its body is not easily fazed.
That's the Claw. Thirty point five points a night in the playoffs, and Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: THE CLAW IN THE PLAYOFFS:|30.5 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: Known as the Drill King, it forms a drill that can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick.
beats.dlg: THE DRILL KING. IT BORES|THROUGH STEEL PLATES.

beats.vo: That's the Siakam spin, drilling to the rim. Sixteen point nine a night, and Most Improved Player.
beats.dlg: THE SIAKAM SPIN:|16.9 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: It has four brains, and together its brains beat a supercomputer.
Our big man spacing the floor. Thirty-eight point two percent from three in the playoffs.
beats.dlg: BIG MARC IN THE PLAYOFFS:|38.2% FROM THREE!

beats.vo: That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league.
beats.dlg: A TEAM WE'RE TAKING INTO|ANY GYM IN THE LEAGUE.

beats.vo: Who would you change? Comment below.

facts.claim: 3P% = three-point (3) field goal percentage, as listed by ESPN
Our starters in the title-clinching Game 6 of the 2019 Finals: Danny Green, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam, Marc Gasol, Kyle Lowry
Leonard, nicknamed the Claw; NBA champion and Finals MVP in 2019 with the Raptors
On Dec. 19, 2021, Lowry drew the 252nd charge of his career, making him the NBA's charges drawn leader for the play-by-play era
Excadrill, known as the Drill King, forms a drill that can bore through a steel plate
Siakam: NBA Most Improved Player in 2019, the first to win the award and an NBA title in the same season
Remoraid's abilities include Sniper; flavor text: superb accuracy, can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet
